description.value: The target returns at 1 Hit Point and wounded 2, permanently marked: it counts as one of your Afflicted for every Choir effect, and it hears the hymn faintly for the rest of its life. A given creature can be returned by On Loan only once, ever.

target.value: 1 creature dead no longer than 1 hour
